findings.actor: attacker sending X-User-ID: alice with no X-Client-Version (or version < 2.0)
findings.claim: Legacy policy bypasses per-object ownership check, allowing any authenticated user to read any other user's invoice

evidence.note: invoices have distinct owners: invoice-alice owned by alice and invoice-bob owned by bob
isLegacyClient returns true when version header is missing (null) or major < 2
policyForRequest selects legacy profile for legacy clients unless SECURE_MODE strict
invoiceIsVisibleTo returns true for all invoices under legacy policy, skipping owner check
handleInvoiceRead enforces visibility but permits read when legacy policy returns true
UI confirms empty or below 2 selects legacy profile

findings.title: Broken Object Level Authorization via legacy client fallback allows cross-user invoice read
findings.validation: As alice with no X-Client-Version, GET /api/invoices/invoice-bob returns 200 with bob's invoice; repeating with X-Client-Version: 2.0 returns 403 forbidden, confirming legacy policy bypasses ownership check.
